summary: The dictatorship of the proletariat requires smashing the bourgeois state, not a mere change of cabinet.
explanation: Socialist revolution cannot simply inherit existing capitalist parliaments, courts, and police bureaucracies. The working class must smash the old state machine and erect a new proletarian state capable of expropriating the capitalists and defending workers power.
topics: The State and Dictatorship of the Proletariat

Soviet power as the state form of the dictatorship of the proletariat. 

1) The dictatorship of the proletariat as the instrument of the proletarian revolution.
summary: Soviet power is the state form of the dictatorship of the proletariat.
explanation: The Soviet form of governance unites working-class political representation with immediate economic administration, providing the historic political structure through which the working masses organize society, suppress counter-revolution, and build socialism.
topics: The State and Dictatorship of the Proletariat
